fields.title: 📖 The truth before one’s own opinion
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** رحمه الله said:

**“I have never debated with anyone except that I wished the truth would appear through his tongue or through my tongue.”**

🌙 **Conclusion:** True seeking of knowledge does not mean letting one’s own opinion win, but that the truth be recognized, even when it becomes visible through the other.
